claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY, not PRIMARY. They excel at citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74) and section cross-lingual alignment (Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150), but FAIL jurist preference gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS jurist preference ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (JP 0.61-0.67) but remain below TF-IDF baseline (0.78-0.79). Product requires multi-view architecture: TF-IDF hybrids for primary navigation; dense for citation heritage and cross-lingual views. 174k dense delivery blocked on corpus lane (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: Verified 17 evidence references spanning: citation heritage at 21/22/24yr (3 files: citation_heritage_21year_latest.json, citation_heritage_22year_latest.json, citation_heritage_24year_latest.json), section cross-lingual at 1K (1 file: section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json), linear combinations at 19/22yr + weight sweep (3 files: weight_sweep_22year_latest.json, linear_combinations_19year_eval_latest.json, linear_hybrid05_concat_22year_eval_latest.json), center projected 22yr evaluation (4 files in evaluation_22year_center_projected/), legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus (1 file: legal_tfidf_bge/all_experiments_results.json), scale characterization 12k (1 file: dense_complementary_characterization/scale_characterization_results.json), formal suite 165k (1 file: partial_dense_2000_2002/evaluation_165k_dense_formal_suite_latest.json), v8 holdout OOS (1 file: v8_holdout_zero_shot_validation/holdout_zero_shot_validation_fixed.json), v17b label normalization (1 file: v17b_label_normalization_all_reps/v17b_label_normalization_all_reps_latest.json), v18 coarse hierarchy (1 file: v18_coarse_hierarchy/v18_coarse_hierarchy_results.json). All source metrics match reported claims.
